#define for_reverse(i,a,b) for(int i=(a);i>=(b);i--)
using namespace std;
const int MAXN=270005;
int m,n,k,mod;
int f[19][MAXN];
vector<long long> g;
int cnt[MAXN];

int normalize(int x){
    if(x<0) return x+mod;
    if(x>=mod) return x-mod;
    return x;
}

void add_value(int &x, const int &y){
    x=normalize(x+y);
}

int power(int base,int exp){
    int result=1;
    while(exp){
        if(exp&1) result=1LL*result*base%mod;
        base=1LL*base*base%mod;
        exp>>=1;
    }
    return result;
}

int factorial[MAXN], inv_factorial[MAXN];

void initialize(int n){
    factorial[0]=1;
    for_range(i,1,n) factorial[i]=1LL*factorial[i-1]*i%mod;
    inv_factorial[n]=power(factorial[n],mod-2);
    for_reverse(i,n-1,0) inv_factorial[i]=1LL*inv_factorial[i+1]*(i+1)%mod;
}

void transform(int *f, int size, int h){
    for(int p=1; p<size; p<<=1)
        for(int i=0; i<size; i+=p<<1)
            for(int k=i; k<i+p; k++)
                add_value(f[k+p], h*f[k]);
}

int l;
vector<long long> operator*(vector<long long> &A, vector<long long> &B){
    static vector<long long> C; C.clear(); C.resize(l+1);
    for(int i=0; i<=l; i++)
        for(int j=0; j<=l-i; j++)
            C[i+j]+=A[i]*B[j];
    for(int i=0; i<=l; i++) C[i]%=mod;
    return C;
}

vector<long long> power_series(vector<long long> A, int k){
    static vector<long long> C; C.clear(); C.resize(l+1);
    C[0]=1;
    while(k){
        if(k&1) C=C*A;
        A=A*A;
        k>>=1;
    }
    return C;
}

int main(){
#ifdef pig
    freopen("C.in","r",stdin);
    freopen("C.out","w",stdout);
#endif
    cin>>n>>k>>mod;
    initialize(n);
    if(n&1){
        cout<<power(k,n);
        return 0;
    }
    m=1; while(m<=n) m<<=1; l++;
    for_range(i,0,m-1) cnt[i]=cnt[i>>1]+(i&1);
    initialize(m);
    for_range(i,0,m-1){
        f[cnt[i]][i]=inv_factorial[i];
    }
    for_range(i,0,l) transform(f[i], m, 1);

        g=power_series(g,k);
        for(int i=0; i<=l; i++) f[i][s]=g[i];

    return 0;
